replication.sql:
-- R-7 supplement q1: the launch specification of the 2026-09-26b subject was APPLIED.
-- A1: the adv_sessions launch receipt for the subject (specificationRevision).
SELECT 'A1' AS block, id, coord_owner_id, launch_spec->>'specificationRevision' AS launch_spec_revision
  FROM harness_shared.adv_sessions
 WHERE id = 30989 AND coord_owner_id = 'su-626b42aa-470d-44d6-9a78-423de618e2e2';
-- A2: every activation event for generations 2-3 on that session (launch -> leadership attach).
SELECT 'A2' AS block, id, phase, source, control_generation, specification_revision, state_revision,
       stack_refs::text, actor_id, principal_id, failure, recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS recorded_at_utc
  FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events
 WHERE workspace_id = 'papercusp-workspace'
   AND owner_id = 'su-626b42aa-470d-44d6-9a78-423de618e2e2'
   AND adv_session_id = 30989
   AND control_generation IN (2, 3)
 ORDER BY id;
-- A3: the persisted span of the applied activation (22467) and of any generation-2 activation.
SELECT 'A3' AS block, activation_event_id, control_generation, specification_revision, stack_refs::text,
       active_from AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS active_from_utc, active_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS active_until_utc
  FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_spans
 WHERE workspace_id = 'papercusp-workspace'
   AND owner_id = 'su-626b42aa-470d-44d6-9a78-423de618e2e2'
   AND adv_session_id = 30989
   AND control_generation IN (2, 3)
 ORDER BY activation_event_id;
output: block | id | phase | source | control_generation | specification_revision | state_revision | stack_refs | actor_id | principal_id | failure | recorded_at_utc
block | activation_event_id | control_generation | specification_revision | stack_refs | active_from_utc | active_until_utc

-- R-7 supplement q2: tool calls billed to the applied launch-specification span (activation 22467).
-- Bounded to the subject and to the window from the gen-2 desired event (22:36:18Z) to the
-- gen-4 applied event (23:14:19.85Z) that closes the gen-3 span.
SELECT 'B1' AS block, identity_activation_event_id, count(*) AS tool_rows,
       min(invoked_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS first_utc, max(invoked_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS last_utc,
       count(DISTINCT identity_specification_revision) AS distinct_specs,
       min(identity_specification_revision) AS spec,
       min(identity_stack_refs::text) AS stack_refs
  FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations_identity_attribution
 WHERE workspace_id = 'papercusp-workspace'
   AND coord_owner_id = 'su-626b42aa-470d-44d6-9a78-423de618e2e2'
   AND invoked_at >= '2026-09-26 22:36:18Z' AND invoked_at < '2026-09-26 23:14:19.851Z'
 GROUP BY identity_activation_event_id
 ORDER BY identity_activation_event_id NULLS FIRST;
output: block | identity_activation_event_id | tool_rows | first_utc | last_utc | distinct_specs | spec | stack_refs
